blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Из Назарета ___ (мочь + ли) быть что доброе?
exercises.prompt: Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?
exercises.why: **мочь → может ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли) я использовать нетбук, стоя в переполненном поезде?
exercises.prompt: Can I use a netbook while standing in a crowded train?
exercises.why: **мочь → Могу ли** — present tense, 1st person singular. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Do you know Noah's ark?
exercises.why: **знать → Знаешь ли** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is wind energy better for the environment?
exercises.why: **являться → Является ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Does counterpropaganda help against propaganda?
exercises.why: **помогать → Помогает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (являться + ли) Гиндза самой оживлённой улицей в Японии?
exercises.prompt: Is the Ginza the busiest street in Japan?
exercises.why: **являться → Является ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Does Celluloid support plugins?
exercises.why: **поддерживать → Поддерживает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (действительно + ли) просмотр фильмов может помочь в овладении языком?
exercises.prompt: Can watching movies really aid in language acquisition?
exercises.why: **Действительно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (действительно): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Will this affect tourism?
exercises.why: **затронуть → Затронет ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Was there an autopsy?
exercises.why: **проводиться → Проводилось ли** — past tense, neut.: drop -ться, add -лось. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: "And do the travellers remember him?"
exercises.why: **вспоминать → вспоминают ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Does a uniform eliminate class difference?
exercises.why: **уничтожать → Уничтожает ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (знать + ли) ты, что иные из самых ярых феминистов — мужчины?
exercises.prompt: Did you know that some of the most ardent feminists are men?
exercises.why: **знать → Знаешь ли** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (существовать + ли) религии, не разрешающие донорство органов?
exercises.prompt: Are there any religions that don't permit organ donation?
exercises.why: **существовать → Существуют ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (действительно + ли) нужен контекст, чтобы понять сослагательное наклонение?
exercises.prompt: Is context really necessary to understand the subjunctive?
exercises.why: **Действительно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (действительно): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is this price acceptable?
exercises.why: **приемлемый → Приемлема ли** — short form (fem.): -а. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Do Peking ducks live in Austria?
exercises.why: **жить → Живут ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Will Frexit follow Brexit?
exercises.why: **последовать → Последует ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Can we clone mammoths?
exercises.why: **мочь → Можем ли** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is it possible for a South Korean to visit North Korea?
exercises.why: **мочь → Может ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.
